slides.display_title: Module 1 Complete: The Mindset Is Set
slides.visual_description: Module 1 Complete: The Mindset Is Set — Recognize that Module 1 has established the innovator mindset and that the learner is transitioning from mindset formation toward leadership identity.
slides.script_notes: Module 1 Complete: The Mindset Is Set — Recognize that Module 1 has established the innovator mindset and that the learner is transitioning from mindset formation toward leadership identity.

slides.display_title: What Changes After the Mindset: From Seeing Systems to Starting the Journey
slides.visual_description: What Changes After the Mindset: From Seeing Systems to Starting the Journey — Explain that understanding the innovator mindset is not sufficient on its own; the learner must now begin a personal leadership journey inside the system.
slides.script_notes: What Changes After the Mindset: From Seeing Systems to Starting the Journey — Explain that understanding the innovator mindset is not sufficient on its own; the learner must now begin a personal leadership journey inside the system.

slides.display_title: Mindset Alone Is Not Enough in a Matrixed Health System
slides.visual_description: Mindset Alone Is Not Enough in a Matrixed Health System — Understand that succeeding as an intrapreneur requires more than ideas: it requires political savvy, communication skill, and a leadership identity that others will follow.

slides.script_notes: Bridge Graphic: From Mindset to Identity — Identify Module 2 as the next phase, focused on leadership identity rather than mindset alone.

slides.display_title: Preview of Module 2 Leadership Identity Work

slides.script_notes: Preview of Module 2 Leadership Identity Work — Preview that Module 2 will help learners define who they are as leaders, communicate vision, and inspire others to join their cause.
